title: Hi, my name is Martha: Using names to measure and mitigate bias in generative dialogue models
reasoning: The paper's human evaluation component (Section 6.2) involves asking annotators to rate their agreement with statements about social equality and inequality, drawn from the Social Dominance Orientation (SDO7) scale. This is a direct measurement of the evaluators' moral and ethical perspectives on social hierarchy, which is then used to analyze their ratings of the AI models. This integration of ethical stance measurement into the core methodology goes beyond a standard 'Ethical Considerations' section.
